milestones.outcome: Every conversation for one exact PR source binding uses one retained file/Git workspace, with independent native sessions and protected legacy migration.
exit_criteria: Shared workspace identity and turn exclusion are exercised across separate conversation scopes and providers through direct and composed paths.
Legacy, changed-source, ownership, cancellation and storage failures preserve work and refuse unsafe dispatch.
Design amendment, tested candidate, evidence and board state are committed; no task-owned commands remain.
The user-required independent critical review of the exact shared-workspace candidate is supplied and every actionable finding is reconciled before acceptance.
milestones.boundary: User mandate pr-shared-workspace-r1; no remote mutations, desktop access or new visual layout.
